correctness.rationale: Sobolewski–Ulas Cor. 3.3 yields chi(4n)=chi(n), chi(8n+2)=T_n, chi(8n+6)=0 and the explicit valuation description. Thue–Morse single-sign sums are O(1) and adjacent-sign correlation has dyadic recurrence C(2M)=-M-C(M), yielding pair frequencies 1/6,1/3,1/3,1/6 with O(log M). The four correct 16-site blocks and eight adjacent transitions yield per block frequencies (1/3,1/3,1/12,1/4,1/4,1/12), then dividing by 4/3 events per block gives asserted probabilities. Independent enumeration of 83,333 successive gaps below n=10^6 gave counts 20834,20833,5209,15624,15625,5208, consistent with limiting weights. Note original paper Prop. 3.4 displays T_n case labels opposite to its Cor.3.3(d); this proof uses the direct recurrence and independently verified block patterns, not the inconsistent printed labels.
